target.title: feat(webchat): rare lobster pet variants incl. retro homage to the classic logo
target.body:
Related: #102754 (follow-up to #102766)

## What Problem This Solves

The sidebar lobster pet shipped with six palettes and one rare (gold). The rarity ladder is shallow — nothing to be delighted about when a session hatches something special.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a rare tier modeled on real lobster genetics, so rarity has lore:

| Variant | Roll | Real-world odds |
|---|---|---|
| blue | 7% | ~1 in 2 million |
| gold (existing) | 5% | ~1 in 30 million |
| calico — orange shell, dark mottled spots | 3% | ~1 in 30 million |
| abyss — deep-sea navy, bioluminescent glowing eye glints | 2% | fantasy |
| ghost/albino — pale translucent shell, icy glints | 1% | ~1 in 100 million |
| split two-tone — bicolor down the midline, mismatched claws + antennae | 1% | ~1 in 50 million |
| **retro — homage to the classic OpenClaw logo: white sticker outline, one oversized raised claw, angry brows, smirk, tall V antennae** | **~0.5%** | **the OG** |

Implementation stays table-driven: new palette entries with weights, two small SVG fragments (calico spot group, split right-half body path), and palette-id CSS classes for the ghost translucency, abyss glow, and split second-color claw/antenna. The offline mode still wins the glint cascade, so disconnected rares go grey-eyed and lose their glow like everyone else. Also removed the unused `--lob-dim` inline variable left over from the pixel-art era.

## User Impact

Session rolls now range from everyday crimson/coral to 1%-grail ghosts and split two-tones. No behavior, config, or a11y changes — reduced-motion and offline semantics are untouched.

## Evidence

![rare variants](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/lobster-pet/rare-variants.png)

Validation (delegated Blacksmith Testbox, `exit=0`):

- `pnpm test ui/src/components/lobster-pet.test.ts` — 11/11, including a rarity-tier test over 20k seeds: every palette (retro included) reachable, grails stay under 3%, commons dominate.
- `pnpm tsgo:test:ui` and `pnpm --dir ui build`.
- Live verification against `pnpm dev:ui:mock`: computed-style probes per variant (ghost svg opacity 0.62 + icy glints, abyss glow drop-shadow, split right-claw/antenna second color, 6 calico spots) the retro mega-claw/face/outline structure, and the offline override forcing grey glints + no glow on an abyss pet; showcase screenshot above captured from the live page.
